card.name: Start of ophthalmic and ovarian words
card.fires_on: The lone letter "o" that begins "ophthalmic" or "ophthalmological" after words like perform, routine, topical or an. It also fires on the "O" at the start of "Ovarian".

modes.label: Ophthalmic exam wording
modes.description: The opening "o" of ophthalmic/ophthalmological in instructions to perform eye examinations or testing.
modes.example: Perform<< o>>phthalmological examination including optical coherence tomography

modes.label: Topical ophthalmic products
modes.description: The opening "o" of ophthalmic after "topical" when describing eye drop use.
modes.example: Latanoprost ophthalmic solution may be used concomitantly with other topical<< o>>phthalmic drug products to lower IOP

modes.label: Ovarian
modes.description: A capital "O" starting the word Ovarian at a sentence start.

card.writes: It favors short fragments like "pt" and "kg" and suppresses "u"-type continuations, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter "o" when "ophthalmic" is split into pieces, mostly in eye-exam instructions.
